benefits.title: Faster Project Execution
benefits.short: Indicative timelines of 30–45 days, depending on size, specifications, and site readiness.
benefits.text: Factory manufacturing helps organise fabrication before delivery. The indicative 30–45 day timeline depends on unit size, final specifications, site readiness, transport, and installation requirements.

benefits.title: Factory-Controlled Manufacturing
benefits.short: A more organised approach to fabrication and assembly before your unit reaches the site.
benefits.text: A dedicated manufacturing process supports a more organised approach to fabrication and assembly, with greater control over production activities before the unit reaches your site.

benefits.title: Purpose-Built Steel Structures
benefits.short: Steel modular structures specified around their intended use and local site conditions.
benefits.text: Our modular units use steel-based construction for practical, modern applications. Final structural specifications should be selected according to the unit’s intended use and site conditions.

benefits.title: Comfort Beyond the Structure
benefits.short: Explore insulation, ventilation, and waterproofing options suited to your climate and application.
benefits.text: Discuss insulation, thermal comfort, waterproofing, ventilation, and window options for your site. Indoor comfort depends on the complete design, materials, orientation, and installation quality.

benefits.title: Modern, Functional Interiors
benefits.short: Available kitchen, bathroom, electrical, furnishing, and window options help make a space practical.
benefits.text: Available features may include a kitchen, bathroom, electrical fittings, air conditioning, furniture, and large windows. The inclusions depend on your selected model and agreed specifications.

benefits.title: A Practical Approach to Cost
benefits.short: Discuss the design, agreed scope, and project inclusions before proceeding.
benefits.text: A defined design and scope help make the project quotation easier to assess. Confirm the unit, transportation, installation, foundation or site preparation, utilities, and any additional charges in the final quotation.

benefits.title: One Connected Process
benefits.short: Design selection, manufacturing, transportation, and installation brought into one connected process.
benefits.text: Smart Cubes brings design selection, manufacturing, transportation, and installation together. Confirm the exact scope, site preparation requirements, and related charges in your project quotation.

benefits.title: Designed for Different Applications
benefits.short: Available configurations serve homes, cottages, hospitality accommodation, and practical workspaces.
benefits.text: From compact homes and farm cottages to resort units, studios, and office cabins, available configurations can serve a range of suitable applications. The right option depends on intended use and site requirements.

process.title: Choose your space
process.text: Discuss intended use, preferred size, available layouts, and the features your project needs.

process.title: Factory manufacturing
process.text: Your selected steel modular structure moves through fabrication and assembly in a controlled factory environment.

process.title: Plan the delivery
process.text: Confirm transport, site access, and preparation requirements before the unit is delivered.

process.title: Install on site
process.text: Transportation and installation follow the scope and site requirements agreed in your project quotation.

specifications.title: Planned unit sizes
specifications.text: Confirm the available dimensions and specifications with our team.

specifications.title: Living configurations
specifications.text: Choose from available designs based on your intended use and site.

specifications.title: Interior options
specifications.text: Finishes, insulation, and furnishing options depend on the selected model.

checklist.title: Location & intended use
checklist.text: Tell us the city or area and whether you need a home, holiday retreat, guest unit, or workspace.

checklist.title: Size & available features
checklist.text: Share your preferred layout, approximate budget, and priorities for the interior.

checklist.title: Site access & preparation
checklist.text: Discuss access, utilities, local permissions, and preparation requirements before installation.

audienceDetails.title: Farmland & farmhouse owners
audienceDetails.text: Create a comfortable space for weekends, family time, or guests, subject to suitable land use and local permissions.

audienceDetails.title: Resorts & homestays
audienceDetails.text: Explore modular cottages and rooms for additional guest accommodation, with practical layouts and a consistent design approach.

audienceDetails.title: Weekend & second-home buyers
audienceDetails.text: Consider compact homes and cottages for personal retreats and time away from the city.

audienceDetails.title: Individual homebuyers
audienceDetails.text: Compare available studio, 1 BHK, and 2 BHK configurations against your intended use and site requirements.

audienceDetails.title: Real estate developers
audienceDetails.text: Discuss suitable development projects, additional accommodation, and project-specific space requirements with our team.

audienceDetails.title: Businesses & commercial projects
audienceDetails.text: Explore office cabins and site offices, with options for layout, electrical fittings, insulation, and installation.
